source_refs.locator: NDC printed pp. 5-6, section 2(c), 'Climate impacts experienced in South Africa'.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC reports recent floods in KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern and Western Cape; Northern Cape/interior heatwaves; droughts in Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Free State; Gauteng storms and Western Cape wildfires. Poor communities suffered most; businesses and municipalities struggled to recover.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

affected_groups: households with unsafe water or toilet access
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The NDC identifies high household climate vulnerability in KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Limpopo and Eastern Cape; eastern Eastern Cape municipalities are more vulnerable. Unsafe water/toilet access and food poverty are prominent.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-10 reports: The 2024 Climate Change Act establishes recurring climate-risk and vulnerability assessments, adaptation planning and reporting for national, provincial and municipal government and identified sectors.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: NDC printed p. 10, Table 1, adaptation Goal 2 and priority interventions for 2031-2035.

evidence.compact_statement: The 2025 NDC sets proposed 2031-2035 priorities for disaster, health, sanitation, emergency accommodation and care support, including informal settlements and marginalized flood-displaced groups. These are policy commitments, not delivered services.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: Workshop synthesis says climate risks were not perceived among municipalities' top ten priorities, making climate response difficult to prioritize amid pressing governance issues.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-03-31 reports: A sector report presented to participants identified water and land stress as compounding climate impacts for smallholder and household producers reliant on rainfall, marginal land, inputs and finance.

evidence.compact_statement: A study of monthly weather and police records for 1,158 South African police wards in 2001-2012 reports warmer-month associations with violent crime and modest rural property-taking responses to growing-season drought, not urban crime. Effects are subtle, mediation is unidentified and weather findings do not establish anthropogenic climate attribution.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
